model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of stimuli types, with a total of six categories represented. The slices are arranged in descending order of size, beginning with "External News Article" shown in green, accounting for approximately 40% of the whole. Following this is "Draft/Other" in purple, which represents about 25%, then "Email" in red at roughly 13%, "Organizational Report" in dark green representing approximately 5%, "Interview" in blue accounting for roughly 5%, and finally "Intra-agency News Article Press Release" in brown, shown at approximately 5%. The chart includes a legend identifying each category, and numerical values are provided for each slice in the format "x/38". The central area of the chart features the label "Stimuli Type" in a dark gray font, and visual emphasis is applied to this central area.
